title: Perceptions of the Dead
description:
The first thing you need to know is that ghosts are real.
The rest, you can only learn on your own.

Follow three stories set in a world where the dead linger, and things far worse wait beyond the veil.The Phantom Ice Cream Truck 
Follow a denizen of the border between life and dead as he answers the call to rescue a missing child.Perceptions of the DeadTyrone has made it his business to help solve the troubles of those afflicted by the undead, but what seems like a case of a benign haunting may find him risking more than his life, but his very soul.Live with Jill CountJill has had moderate success as a streamer, and to mix things up, this Halloween she is going to life-stream a visit to a haunted hospital. The twist? It's actually haunted.
